description: OpenModelica is an open-source, Modelica-based modelling and simulation environment for industrial and academic use, whose long-term development is supported by the non-profit Open Source Modelica Consortium (OSMC). Its goal is an open-source Modelica modelling, compilation and simulation environment distributed as binaries and source code for research, teaching and industry. The site offers source code and nightly builds, library coverage reports showing which open-source Modelica libraries work in OpenModelica, porting advice, interactive tutorials, an OMWebbook of examples, a Jupyter notebook Modelica mode and ModelicaML for systems engineering. Release news lists v1.27.1 on 2026-09-08 and v1.27.0 on 2026-07-07; official releases carry validated features, stable dev and beta versions come between them, and nightly builds are not for productive use. Coverage: generic; for buildings it runs Modelica libraries such as the LBNL Buildings and IBPSA libraries, subject to the coverage reports. Access: free download for Windows and other systems, with all previous releases archived. Licence: OSMC Public License (OSMC-PL 1.8 with contributor agreement). Caveats: library support varies, so the coverage reports should be checked before relying on a building library. Simulation uses: equation-based HVAC, district heating and control simulation, co-simulation through FMI, and digital twin models of building systems. Related records: the Modelica Buildings and IBPSA libraries, Dymola and the BCVTB.
